notes.title: Demo Gameplay Now Exists
notes.content:
Previously, a bug caused the demo to play with no content.

Demo gameplay content has now been activated.

You'll start the tutorial automatically, meet the shaman, unlock your basic abilities, complete the tutorial, and then play the game as normal - with all current content.

Thanks for your patience; please pardon our dust.


-Alex

notes.title: Roast Mr. K.I.S.S.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44606297/c349af1139aaed1eebab4139399a69725bb63562.jpg[/img]

Now's your chance; give Mr. K.I.S.S. your harshest, funniest, sweetest, or most analytical feedback.
[olist]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2514310/Mr_KISS/]Install the free demo.[/url]
[*] Play infinitely.
[*] Select "Survey" in the menu.
[*] Roast Mr. K.I.S.S.
[/olist]
Future demo updates will be [i]finite[/i], so get it while it's hot.

Thanks for checking out the free Mr. K.I.S.S. Infinite Gameplay Demo!


-Alex
